WHERE senderCount > 100
RETURN beneficiary.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (beneficiary:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE size((beneficiary)<-[:TRANSFER]-()) > 100
RETURN beneficiary.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit
